card.text: Explore Ganymede in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Voyager and Galileo imagery of Jupiter’s largest moon and its grooved icy surface.

introduction.text: Ganymede is the largest moon in the solar system. Bright grooved ice crosses ancient dark terrain, above an ocean thought to lie beneath its crust.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Source detail ranges from 400 m to 20 km per pixel. Photographed shadows remain; the gray grid marks missing imagery.

enhanced.title: Color mosaic
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and violet bands add color to monochrome detail. Missing or synthesized color is left monochrome.

geology.title: Global geologic map
geology.summary: Twenty-three archived map symbols distinguish interpreted dark and light terrains, crater and basin materials. Colors are categorical display choices. The GIS combines palimpsest age classes under p; the view preserves that combined symbol. Gray grid marks areas without an unambiguous polygon. No measured relief is added.

oxygen-signature.title: Oxygen-sensitive visible reflectance ratio
oxygen-signature.summary: A 565/577.3 nm surface-ice oxygen signature, not oxygen concentration. These 2° samples have approximate registration. Gray grid marks missing or withheld data; joins between nights remain.
